title: Korea10K: analysis and figure-generation code
description:
Analysis and figure-generation code for Korea10K: 10,239 whole genomes with multiomic and clinical health information as the Korean multiomics reference dataset.

The repository contains the pipelines for population structure (PCA, ADMIXTURE), sequencing depth, HLA typing comparison, imputation reference panel construction and evaluation, variant discovery saturation, and the effect of CpG-eliminating variants on methylation arrays, together with the scripts that render the manuscript figures and tables.

This is a code release, not a runnable end-to-end pipeline: the scripts expect the project's genotype, methylation and metadata files to exist on disk and call external tools (PLINK 2, ADMIXTURE, SHAPEIT5, Minimac3/4, bcftools, GATK, GLIMPSE2) that must be installed separately.
